cohort: The study included 1,322 pregnant women exposed to reported domestic violence and 485,981 pregnant women without reported domestic violence, all from national databases in Taiwan.
finding: Domestic violence during pregnancy was significantly associated with a higher risk of low birthweight in full-term neonates (OR 1.37, 95% CI 1.05, 1.79), but not significantly associated with low birthweight in preterm neonates.
